findings.note: Covers' preview says Atlanta lost its last two games by a combined 33 points, traded away starting C Ryan Neuzil and S Jessie Bates III this week, and has seen QB Michael Penix Jr. throw five interceptions in two games; it also says Mahomes was a full practice participant despite his elbow injury.

The Falcons' official site says LB Divine Deablo was downgraded to out, WR Zachariah Branch is out, and DT Gervon Dexter Sr. and edge James Pearce Jr. are questionable, which thins Atlanta's defense against Kansas City.

ESPN reports that Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker III is out with a groin injury he reported before Friday's practice; RB Jaydn Ott is also questionable, and OT Jaylon Moore and DT Peter Woods are out for Kansas City.
